tip: Söz vermek joins the noun söz (word) with vermek (give) to mean promise, not literally to give a word.
temizletti is temizle (clean) plus causative -t: make someone clean. bana marks the person who gets made to do it.
The -muş in unutmuşum marks something noticed after the fact: I seem to have forgotten, not a plain I forgot.
uyumadan önce means before sleeping: a verb stem plus -madan önce builds before doing something.
koşarak is koş (run) plus -arak, meaning by running or while running: it says how the main action happened.
Annemin yaptığı means the one my mom makes: -dığı builds a relative clause, and the doer Annem takes -in.
olsaydık paired with yapmazdık is the past unreal conditional: if we had been, we would not have made it.
çaldığında means when it rings: add -dığında to a verb stem to say at the time something happens.
annemden uses the ablative -den to mark the source you learn from: learned from my mother.
gelince means once it comes: -ince attaches to a verb stem for as soon as something happens.
oluşturmaktadır is the formal -makta present: same meaning as -yor but used in official or written Turkish.
Ne kadar paired with o kadar frames the more ... the more: Ne kadar çok egzersiz, o kadar iyi.
vapurla is vapur (ferry) plus -la, the by or with ending: by ferry, with no separate word for by needed.
olmalı adds -malı to ol-, meaning should or must be: it states obligation or a firm opinion.
sorar uses the aorist -ar for habitual actions, matching her akşam (every evening): things done regularly.
